questions.question: Harry Kane was awarded the Ballon d'Or last night (Monday). How many years has it been since an English player won it?
questions.explanation: The quarter-century gap highlights just how rare the prestigious award has been for English footballers in the modern era. It represents a quarter of a century of waiting for an English winner.

questions.question: Who was the last English player to win the Ballon d'Or?

questions.question: Which Premier League team has the longest-serving manager?

questions.question: How many Premier League titles has Frank Lampard won during his career?
questions.explanation: He won all three of his Premier League title medals as Chelsea's star midfielder in 2004–05, 2005–06, and 2009–10. The number of titles he won matches the number of stumps in a cricket wicket.

questions.question: Who holds the record for the most clean sheets in Premier League history?
